svg.title: Qualify the client at the intended operating point
svg.desc: Independent constructed resource bounds • no hardware measurement
svg.text: Qualify the client at the intended operating point
Independent constructed resource bounds • no hardware measurement
CPU work has a finite budget
200 µs per attempt; one dedicated core
Ideal ceiling 5,000 attempts per second
4,000/s requires 0.8 core-seconds/s
Count network directions separately
2,048 request; 8,192 response bytes
Payload only; framing and copies excluded
Slots retain work for its lifetime
32 slots held 40 ms → mean bound 800/s
4,000/s × 40 ms → mean 160 slots
256 slots does not guarantee burst fit
Qualify the actual response shape
Size, fragments, latency and arrival trace
Compare actual dispatch with server receipt
Check client and server resource evidence
A cheap immediate responder cannot establish fidelity for long, large streamed replies.
Removing one limit does not prove headroom, useful output quality or server capacity.
